observations: Black game console with a two-tone matte finish on the top surface.
Two wireless controllers: one light blue with red thumbsticks and buttons, one dark blue/purple.
The console design is consistent with a Sony PlayStation 4 (original/fat model).
Watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' and 'POSTED ON Jiji' visible on the image.
No visible ports, serial numbers, or warranty seals in the single provided photo.

claims.evidence: Requires a photo of the System Information screen showing a firmware version of 9.00 or lower.
EA Sports FC 26 does not exist; the current version is FC 24 and the upcoming version is FC 25.
No photo of the digital library or physical game discs.
The warranty seals on the rear of the console are not shown.
Labels on the underside of the controllers are not visible to confirm authenticity.
The receipt is mentioned but not pictured.

risks.risk: The console is not actually jailbroken (hacked), which is a major price driver.
risks.proof: Photo of Settings > System > System Information showing the software version.

risks.risk: The console is an early, less reliable hardware revision (CUH-10xx or 11xx).
risks.proof: Photo of the model number label on the rear or bottom of the unit.
risks.if_unproven: as the earliest, least reliable hardware revision

risks.risk: The controllers are third-party clones rather than original Sony DualShock 4s.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the labels on the back of both controllers.

risks.risk: The console is banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: Video showing the console successfully connecting to the PlayStation Store.

proof_requests: Photo of the System Information screen showing the software version.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and warranty seals.
Photo of the back of both controllers.
Photo of the game library on the TV screen.
response.reason: The 'hacked' status and the specific hardware model (CUH-1200 vs earlier) are critical for pricing. The claim of 'FC26' is impossible, which makes the other software claims highly suspect without visual proof.
